cli.help:
Tomorrow Drop: send files and text on the local network.

Usage: tdrop <command> [options]

Commands:
  discover [--target IP:port]      list the devices on the network
  pair <device> [--name NAME]      pair with a device (you compare fingerprints)
  send <file>... --to <device>     send files to a paired device
  send --stdin --to <device>       send the text read from standard input
  receive [--out DIR]              wait for one transfer, then exit
  daemon [--out DIR]               keep receiving until interrupted
  trust list                       list the paired devices
  trust remove <id>                unpair a device
  identity show                    show this device's fingerprint
  config language [auto|pt-BR|en]  show or set the language
  version                          show the version

<device> is an IP:port or the name of a device found on the network.
